dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: Many see me as a solitary, mysterious person.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: In truth, I do not mind mingling with the crowd. People-watching is also one of my interests.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: Of course, whether those in the crowd would enjoy seeing me... is a completely different matter.
